children: Insider trades occurred at firms including PepsiCo
this week. The following transactions took place between October 12 and October 16.
EVP William Wilcox sold 1,100 shares at $958.21 each for a total value of about $1.05M. The transaction represented about 26.23% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 3,094 shares.
Chief Executive Officer John Giamatteo sold 27,004 shares at $8.36 each for $225,753. The sale accounted for about 3.30% of his direct holdings, reducing it to 792,494 shares.
Chief Executive Officer Samarth Kulkarni sold 4,098 shares at $49.26 each for about $201,867. The transaction represented about 1.55% of his direct holdings, reducing his stake to 259,736 shares.

Director Jarrod Patten sold 2,750 shares in the price range of $150.54 to $158 per share for a total value of $422,225. The sale accounted for about 3.64% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 72,742 shares.
director Robert Pohlad purchased 184,646 shares at $128.28 each for ~$23.69M, increasing his holdings to 455,990 shares.
CEO Ryan Cohen purchased 844,130 shares at around $27 each for approximately $22.77M, increasing his direct holdings to 42.49M shares.
Executive Chairman Alan Gold purchased 40,000 shares at $25 each for $1M, bringing his total direct holdings to 40,000 shares.
